name: Dust2.us
description: A Counter-Strike-focused esports publication covering teams, players, tournaments, and the North American scene.
coverageDisclosure: Internal provenance: in-universe coverage attribution is maintained for canon validation. Do not display to readers.
notes: Used once in-universe for the Episode 98 roster feature filmed at the Kairos campus; Dust2.us has no other editorial role in the Kairos Universe continuity.
The episode never confirms a real-world Dust2.us release date for the footage; Kairospedia's archive entry records only when Kairospedia itself compiled the public page, not an outlet broadcast date.
